title: Layout Test
description: Internal QA page - not for public use.

sections.content:
### TEST 1: layout=text-only, full stack (eyebrow/H1/subline/body/list/inline image/CTA button/plain link)

# This is the headline (H1)

#### This is the subline (H4), a longer intro sentence that sits below the headline and above the body copy.

This is a regular body paragraph with **bold text** and *italic text* to check inline formatting.

- Bullet one
- Bullet two with **bold** inside it

![Inline test image](/images/sunset-mountains.png)

```cta
{"label":"CTA Button (primary)","link":"/contact-us"}
```

[Plain markdown link (secondary style) →](/services)

### TEST 2: layout=image-left, H2 headline (not H1)

## Headline using H2 instead of H1

Body paragraph for the image-left layout test. The image should appear on the left, this text column on the right.

```cta
{"label":"CTA in image-left","link":"#"}
```

### TEST 3: layout=image-right

## Headline for image-right test

Body paragraph for the image-right layout. The image should appear on the right, this text column on the left.

### TEST 3b: layout=hero-image-right, full-bleed hero treatment (H1/body/CTA)

# Hero headline (H1), larger than other page headlines

Body paragraph for the hero-image-right layout. Image should bleed to the true viewport edge on large screens with a top fade mask, no rounded corners.

```cta
{"label":"Hero CTA button","link":"#"}
```

### TEST 3c: layout=hero-image-left, mirrored full-bleed hero treatment

# Hero headline on the right side this time

Body paragraph for the hero-image-left layout. Image should bleed to the left edge on large screens, text column on the right.

### TEST 4: layout=gallery (4 images)

## Gallery layout headline

Body paragraph next to a 4-image gallery grid.

```cta
{"label":"CTA in gallery","link":"#"}
```

### TEST 5b: layout=overlay-left, full bleed image with text overlaid on the left, dark theme

# Overlay Left Headline

#### Subline text over the image, should be white/light for contrast.

Body paragraph over the image, also light-colored for readability against the dark gradient scrim.

```cta
{"label":"Overlay CTA button","link":"#"}
```

[Overlay plain link →](#)

### TEST 5c: layout=overlay-right, full bleed image with text overlaid on the right

## Overlay Right Headline (H2)

Body paragraph over the image, text should sit on the right side this time with the gradient mirrored.
TEST 6: layout=text-only, plain paragraph only, no headings at all - checking default spacing with nothing above it.
